title: WSE Calendar route table
description: A compiled kCalendarRoute table plus its metadata, as emitted by wse_model.calendar.table.CalendarRouteTable.to_dict. The schema name is part of the consumption contract: consumers must reject any other value. Enforced by tests/contracts/test_table_schema.py.

node_count.description: rows * cols. 40 for the Calendar baseline, 48 for the whitepaper hardware reading (open item Q1).

route_bits_bits.description: 2 * node_count: the routeBits width in bits.

layout.description: key-major is the design-document baseline; node-major is the C-9 variant that cuts per-core D-cache residency by 4x with identical instruction count and total bytes.

versions.description: The three version numbers checked together at load time. Any mismatch must fault rather than degrade (whitepaper 10.3, HW-13).

key_count.description: Number of logical identities. Calendar 2.6 caps this at 16.

d_cache_lines_per_core.description: Lines a core residents with this layout: key_count under key-major, ceil(key_count/4) under node-major.

route_key.description: The logical identity: {programId, kernelId, phaseId, collective, groupRole}. It determines the opcode outright.

group_role.description: A role such as ROW(my_row), not a concrete group: under SPMD a kernel can only name the group it is in.

member_nodes.description: Cores that participate in this collective. Non-members carry an all-zero row.

groups.description: Per-source resolved destination set, keyed by node id. A single set is not enough under SPMD because each source's group differs.

self_delivery.description: FabricSelfDelivery. Must agree with the source's own L bit.

arm_lead_cycles.description: NoC/BSP-reserved window after alignment for the receive command and every send descriptor to be enqueued.

conflict_proof.description: The NoC algorithm's proof that the same-opcode no-conflict and no-concurrency guarantees hold. The model records it and never re-derives it.

r1_aligned.description: R-1: the send row stride is a 32 B multiple.

entries.description: One 16 B entry per node, in node order.

route_bits.description: Space-separated uppercase hex, LSB-first byte order, 2 bits per node with bit(2i+1)=P_i and bit(2i)=L_i.

land_count.description: popcount(L). Carried for cross-checking against the bitmap.

flags.description: bit0 isMember, bit1 isRoot, bit2 selfLand.

expected_rx_bytes.description: The device-side expVal: sum over sources whose L bit lands here of rowCount * rowBytes.
